package.name: hyu_lite_sim
package.description: Lightweight (no Gazebo) vehicle + sensor simulator for the FSK stack: a bicycle-model car, an emulated SBG Ellipse-D (raw imu_data / gps_pos / gps_vel / gps_hdt), an emulated ECU (UDP command in, per-wheel RPM feedback out, through the real drive_udp_bridge) and an emulated perception output (/perception/cones) from a track csv plus off-track clutter that shows up as unknown-colour cones. Runs on the Jetson.
